summary: Full e2e testing of the new React web frontend against the unchanged FastAPI backend for SafeQR/Nek Saathi. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed covering auth, vehicles CRUD, contacts, lost mode, public QR lookup + alert, alerts feed, admin stats/users/suspend guard. Frontend: 12/12 UI flows passed - landing render, owner login, vehicle add, vehicle detail (QR canvas, copy/download/preview/lost-mode), contact add, public scan + emergency alert -> success, alerts feed, auth-guard redirect, admin login + stats + user search, non-admin redirect from /admin.

minor.issue: Returns {count, results} envelope (not a raw list). Frontend already handles this correctly via .data.results — noting only for future test writers.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~3000+ lines in a single file — recommend splitting into routers (auth, vehicles, tags, admin, public, billing) for maintainability. Non-blocking for MVP.
REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is correctly used via env in frontend/src/lib/api.js. Bearer token interceptor is clean.
AuthContext properly clears token on /auth/me failure. Protected route wrapper correctly handles adminOnly.
No _id leaks observed — server.py uses clean() helper throughout.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@safeqr.com / admin1234 (seeded). Owner demo: demo_web@safeqr.com / demo1234 (pre-created).
seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_ prefixed vehicles + one contact + one emergency alert under demo_web owner. No cleanup performed (data is disposable in preview DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_web_flows.py. Note pytest.ini uses xdist -n auto which requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var; run as: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_web_flows.py -o addopts=''` to bypass xdist arg mismatch. Admin /api/admin/users returns {count, results} envelope. Public alert rate limit is 20/min — space out test runs if hitting it.
